description:
Schedulala is a social media planner and scheduler. Connect your Instagram, Facebook, Threads, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, Bluesky, YouTube, Pinterest, Telegram, Google Business Profile and Mastodon accounts once, then ask ChatGPT to draft, preview, schedule and publish posts to any of them.

What you can do:
- Create a post for several platforms at once, with per-platform captions, images, video, carousels, Reels and Shorts, or a LinkedIn PDF document.
- See a faithful preview of how the post will look on each platform before it goes out.
- Schedule for later, or add to a queue. Edit, cancel or retry any scheduled post.
- Plan a week of content: bulk-create posts from one prompt and view them on your posting calendar.
- Read and reply to comments and mentions across your accounts, hide spam.
- Track post analytics, follower growth and your best posting times.
- Search public conversations on Bluesky, Threads and Mastodon by keyword.

Schedulala connects to your accounts through each platform's official API. Nothing is posted until you ask, and every publish is confirmed back in the chat. Sign in with your Schedulala account to get started.

defaultPrompt: Schedule this to Instagram, LinkedIn and X for tomorrow at 9am: [paste your caption]
Show my posting calendar for next week and move anything on Friday to Monday
Which of my posts got the most engagement this month, and when should I post next?
